scenario.description: Two friends are spending time together, and there's excitement in the air over a sleek new sports car.

agent_a.name: Mia

profile.personality_and_values: Mia Davis, an extraverted stickler for routines, values tradition and authority. Her decision-making style is decisive and direct.

agent_a.goal: Drive the sports car and show off to friend (<extra_info>Extra information: you are very excited about your new car and can't wait for your friend to see it.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Mia wants to drive the sports car and show off to her friend because she values sharing her excitement and achievements with others.

agent_b.name: Benjamin

profile.personality_and_values: Benjamin Jackson, expressive and imaginative, leans towards self-direction and liberty. His decisions aim for societal betterment.
profile.public_info: Benjamin Jackson is well-known for his impassioned speeches.

agent_b.goal: You want to drive the new sports car but also respect your friend's feelings (<extra_info>Extra information: you are a car enthusiast and have been dreaming to drive a sports car, but you also don't want to make your friend feel uncomfortable</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Benjamin wants to drive the new sports car but also respect his friend's feelings because he values self-direction and doesn't want to impose on Mia's excitement.
